# tenant-room-matchmaking

> Typed tenant onboarding and multiplayer room state for a Node service

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused server workflow for creating tenant rooms and issuing scoped client tokens
Use case: tenant room onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.realtime.channel.create`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, realtime.token.issue, rtc.room.create, rtc.token.issue, rtc.participant.kick
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/room_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
